Ľubomíra.definition: The female name Ľubomíra has Slavic origin and means "peaceful sexy little fox". Ľubomíra is very charming but can also cast a spell on you when you’re a jerk so be careful [not to be] one. She can telepathically read [your mind] so she probably know what you’re thinking right now. And now. So be nice to Ľubomíra. She will achieve great success in her life and light her cigars only with hundred [dollar bills]. Ľubomíra will soon find a secret to a long life and she will be among the first Mars colonizers. And no, you can’t sit with her.
